About.title: About NX Studio
About.whoWeAreDesc: NX Studio is a technology development company founded by Sebastián Velasco Ocampo, a Systems Engineer specialized in creating custom solutions for the Latin American market. We combine the agility and cultural understanding of regional teams with the technical rigor and scalability of global software development best practices.
About.myBackgroundDesc: With over 4 years of experience in full-stack development, systems architecture, and practical application of artificial intelligence, I have led projects ranging from cross-platform desktop applications to algorithmic trading SaaS platforms and electoral fraud detection systems. My approach combines deep technical expertise with an understanding of the specific challenges of the Latin American context: intermittent connectivity, local regulations, financial inclusion needs, and cultural adaptation.
